meta.title: Thermal Conductivity Converter — Convert Watt/(m·K) and More
meta.description: Free thermal conductivity converter for 4+ units including Watt/(m·K), cal/(s·cm·°C), BTU/(h·ft·°F). Instant, accurate, browser-based.

content.intro: W/(m·K), BTU/(h·ft·°F). Convert between 4 thermal conductivity units instantly, with engineering-grade precision and no signup required.
content.result_section: Pick any two units below to convert between them. The base unit for thermal conductivity in this tool is **WmK**; every conversion routes through it for consistency.
content.formula_section: Most thermal conductivity conversions are a single multiplication by a fixed factor. Temperature is the notable exception — it uses additive offsets, not just multiplication. The converter handles both transparently.

content.use_cases:
- Cooking, baking, and oven temperature checks across recipes.
- Weather and climate comparisons across regions.
- HVAC sizing, where loads are quoted in BTU, kW, or tons.
- Lab work and material processing temperature setpoints.
- Industrial process control in mixed-unit environments.
content.tips:
Bookmark the conversions you use most — each pair has its own dedicated page with formulas, a lookup table, and FAQs.

When working with derived units (area, volume), remember the factor scales with the dimension: a length factor f becomes f² for area and f³ for volume.
